job.style: a conversation between a teacher and two students

response.passage: In our computer lab, Ms. Sharma explained how AI works. Rohan asked, 'Is AI just a robot that looks like a human?' Ms. Sharma smiled and said, 'Not at all. AI is software that learns from data, not necessarily a physical robot.' Priya then asked if AI is always perfect. Ms. Sharma replied, 'Actually, AI can make mistakes because it learns from patterns in data, not by knowing everything. If we show an AI thousands of photos of only cats, it will get better at recognizing cats, but it will not suddenly learn how to drive a car or write a poem.' Rohan wondered if chatbots have feelings. Ms. Sharma clarified, 'Chatbots are just programs processing information; they do not feel happy or sad when you talk to them.' Finally, she warned them, 'Even if a chatbot writes very confidently, it might still be wrong. Always check important information from reliable sources instead of trusting the AI blindly just because it sounds sure.'
response.summary: Artificial intelligence is software that learns from data patterns rather than being a human-like robot. Because AI learns from specific examples, it is not perfect and cannot perform every task, nor does it have human emotions.
